  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags)) cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_user_requested = 1 OR (cf_auto_failed = 0 AND cf_user = 1))) user_cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_user_requested = 0 AND (cf_auto_failed = 1 OR (cf_user = 0 AND cf_auto_period = 1)))) auto_cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_still_paid = 1)) cancelled_active_users
FROM finx

GROUP BY c_date, c_funnel, c_camp)

WITH

base AS (
  SELECT a.user_id uid, a.transaction_id tid, a.event_time et, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(a.event_time) ets,
    a.normalized_email normalized_email, ifNull(a.source_updated_at, a.clickhouse_synced_at) source_updated_at,
    a.funnel funnel, a.campaign_path campaign_path,
    a.campaign_id campaign_id,
    ifNull(nullIf(JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, 'traffic_source'), ''), 'unknown') traffic_source,
    a.country_code country_code, a.card_type card_type, a.platform platform, a.media_buyer media_buyer,
    multiIf(a.transaction_type = 'trial', 0, a.transaction_type = 'upsell', 1, a.transaction_type = 'first_subscription', 2,
      a.transaction_type IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal'), 3, 4) tprio,
    a.status status, a.is_success is_success, a.transaction_type ttype,
    positionCaseInsensitive(a.billing_reason, 'upsell') > 0 upmark,
    ((a.currency = 'USD' AND (abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 4.99) < 0.005 OR abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 9.99) < 0.005 OR abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 24.99) < 0.005))
      OR (a.currency = 'EUR' AND abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 4.99) < 0.005)
      OR (a.currency = 'COP' AND abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 17199) < 0.005)) tokenAmt,
    abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 14.98) < 0.01 commonUp,
    multiIf(a.status = 'failed', 'failed_payment', a.status = 'refunded', 'refund', a.status = 'chargeback', 'chargeback', '') statusType,
    a.gross_amount_usd g, floor(a.net_amount_usd * 100 + 0.5) / 100 nn, floor(a.refund_amount_usd * 100 + 0.5) / 100 rr,
    a.currency cur, toFloat64(a.original_amount) amt, a.product_id pid, a.product_name pname
  FROM analytics_transactions AS a FINAL 
  WHERE a.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
),
elig AS (SELECT *, (statusType = '' AND NOT upmark AND NOT tokenAmt) lifeelig FROM base),
tr AS (
  SELECT uid, argMin(ets, (ets, tprio, tid)) trial_ts, min((ets, tprio, tid)) trial_key,
    argMin(toString(toDate(et)), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_date,
    argMin(funnel, (ets, tprio, tid)) c_funnel,
    argMin(if(campaign_path = '', 'unknown', campaign_path), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_camp,
    argMin(if(campaign_id = '', 'unknown', campaign_id), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_campaign_id,
    argMin(if(traffic_source = '', 'unknown', traffic_source), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_traffic_source
  FROM elig WHERE lifeelig GROUP BY uid
),
userdim AS (
  SELECT uid,
    argMin(country_code, (multiIf(country_code = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_country,
    argMin(if(card_type = '', 'unknown', card_type), (multiIf(card_type = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_card_type,
    argMin(if(platform = '', 'unknown', platform), (multiIf(platform = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_platform,
    argMin(if(media_buyer = '', 'Unknown', media_buyer), (ets, tid)) u_media_buyer,
    argMin(normalized_email, (multiIf(normalized_email = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_normalized_email,
    max(source_updated_at) u_source_updated_at
  FROM base GROUP BY uid
),
cl AS (
  SELECT e.uid uid, e.tid tid, e.et et, e.ets ets,
    e.normalized_email normalized_email, e.source_updated_at source_updated_at,
    e.funnel funnel, e.campaign_path campaign_path, e.campaign_id campaign_id, e.traffic_source traffic_source,
    e.country_code country_code, e.card_type card_type, e.media_buyer media_buyer,
    e.tprio tprio, e.status status, e.is_success is_success, e.upmark upmark, e.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    e.commonUp commonUp, e.statusType statusType, e.g g, e.nn nn, e.rr rr,
    e.cur cur, e.amt amt, e.pid pid, e.pname pname, e.lifeelig lifeelig,
    tr.trial_ts trial_ts, tr.trial_key trial_key, tr.c_date c_date, tr.c_funnel c_funnel, tr.c_camp c_camp,
	    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
	    userdim.u_country u_country, userdim.u_card_type u_card_type, userdim.u_platform u_platform, userdim.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
	    userdim.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, userdim.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at
  FROM elig e INNER JOIN tr USING(uid)
  INNER JOIN userdim USING(uid)
  WHERE floor((e.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) >= 0
),
pretyped AS (
  SELECT *, floor((ets - trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    multiIf(statusType != '', statusType, upmark, 'upsell', (NOT upmark) AND tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      lifeelig AND (ets, tprio, tid) = trial_key, 'trial',
      lifeelig AND (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      lifeelig AND (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      lifeelig, 'lifecycle', 'upsell') pretype
  FROM cl
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
upsidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) slot FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'upsell' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (
  SELECT p.uid uid, p.tid tid, p.et et, p.ets ets, p.tprio tprio, p.trial_ts trial_ts,
    p.is_success is_success, p.g g, p.nn nn, p.rr rr, p.d d, p.statusType statusType, p.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    p.cur cur, p.amt amt, p.pid pid, p.pname pname,
    p.c_date c_date, p.c_funnel c_funnel, p.c_camp c_camp,
    p.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, p.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    p.u_country u_country, p.u_card_type u_card_type, p.u_platform u_platform, p.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    p.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, p.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl, ifNull(ui.slot, 0) slot,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid) LEFT JOIN upsidx ui USING(uid, tid)
)
SELECT lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM userdim.u_normalized_email)) email,
  tr.c_date cohort_date, tr.c_funnel funnel, tr.c_camp campaign_path
FROM tr INNER JOIN userdim USING(uid)
WHERE userdim.u_normalized_email != ''
FORMAT JSONEachRow

WITH fcm AS (
  SELECT canonical_user_id, funnel, campaign_path, campaign_id, traffic_source,
    media_buyer, country, card_type, platform, currency, price_plan, trial_transaction_id
  FROM fact_user_cohorts FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND warehouse_version = {warehouse_version:String}
    AND classification_version = {classification_version:String}
    AND toString(cohort_date) >= {o_date_from:String}
),
tutm AS (
  SELECT transaction_id, utm_source
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND utm_source != ''
),
members AS (
  SELECT fcm.canonical_user_id canonical_user_id, fcm.funnel funnel, fcm.campaign_path campaign_path,
    fcm.campaign_id campaign_id, fcm.traffic_source traffic_source, fcm.media_buyer media_buyer,
    fcm.country country, fcm.card_type card_type, fcm.platform platform, fcm.currency currency, fcm.price_plan price_plan,
    ifNull(tutm.utm_source, '') trial_utm,
    1 AS m_funnel,
    1 AS m_campaign_path,
    1 AS m_campaign_id,
    1 AS m_traffic_source,
    1 AS m_media_buyer,
    1 AS m_country,
    1 AS m_card_type,
    1 AS m_platform,
    1 AS m_currency,
    1 AS m_price_plan
  FROM fcm LEFT JOIN tutm ON tutm.transaction_id = fcm.trial_transaction_id
)
SELECT 'funnel' dim, funnel value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY funnel
UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign_path' dim, campaign_path value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY campaign_path
UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign_id' dim, campaign_id value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY campaign_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'traffic_source' dim, traffic_source value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY traffic_source
UNION ALL SELECT 'media_buyer' dim, media_buyer value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY media_buyer
UNION ALL SELECT 'country' dim, country value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY country
UNION ALL SELECT 'card_type' dim, card_type value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY card_type
UNION ALL SELECT 'platform' dim, platform value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY platform
UNION ALL SELECT 'currency' dim, currency value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY currency
UNION ALL SELECT 'price_plan' dim, price_plan value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members  GROUP BY price_plan
UNION ALL SELECT '_scope' dim, '_scope' value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members 
UNION ALL SELECT 'utm_source' dim, trial_utm value, uniqExact(canonical_user_id) cnt FROM members WHERE trial_utm != '' AND trial_utm NOT IN ({o_utm_mapped_0:String}, {o_utm_mapped_1:String}, {o_utm_mapped_2:String}) GROUP BY trial_utm
FORMAT JSONEachRow

      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'upsell',
      tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      'lifecycle') ocat,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upmark',
      (NOT tokenAmt) AND tid = trial_transaction_id, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'price_marked',
      tokenAmt, 'token_amount',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'common_up',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'fallback_app_2m',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'fallback_token_48h',
      'lifecycle') orule,
    if(statusType != '', statusType, ocat) pretype
  FROM base
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (
  SELECT p.uid uid, p.tid tid, p.et et, p.is_success is_success,
    p.g g, p.rr rr, p.d d,
    p.c_d c_d, p.c_camp c_camp, p.c_plan c_plan,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid)
)
SELECT toString(toDate(et)) day,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1) gross,
  sum(rr) refunds,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toDate(et) = c_d) gross_new_day,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) gross_new_week,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) gross_new_month,
  sumIf(rr, toDate(et) = c_d) refunds_new_day,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) refunds_new_week,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) refunds_new_month,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND c_d > toDate(et)) future_cohort_gross,
  
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'trial') type_trial,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'first_subscription') type_first_sub,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal')) type_renewals,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('upsell','app_upsell')) type_upsells,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') type_tokens,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1) paying_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toDate(et) = c_d) new_paying_users_day,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) new_paying_users_week,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) new_paying_users_month,
  countIf(is_success = 1) rows_scanned
FROM fin
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
FORMAT JSONEachRow

WITH

  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM normalized_email)) != ''
),
csub AS (
  SELECT s.normalized_email sub_email, s.subscription_id sid, s.cancelled_at cancelled_at, s.period_ends_at period_ends_at,
    s.started_at started_at,
    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM s.cancellation_reason)) = 'user requested cancellation' user_requested,
    (s.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.period_ends_at > now64(3, 'UTC')
      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''
  ) AS ft ON ft.fail_email = c.sub_email
  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,
    max(c.user_requested) cf_user_requested,
    max(c.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto)) cf_auto_failed,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND (c.user_requested OR (c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
      AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND c.cancelled_at < c.period_ends_at))) cf_user,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),

'price_01M2SSMMES8JY55CMX80GKHCYX') OR startsWith(a.price_point, 'price_web_tokens'), 'token_purchase',

fin AS (

    p.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, p.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl, ifNull(ui.slot, 0) slot,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid) LEFT JOIN upsidx ui USING(uid, tid)
)
, 
cemail AS (
  SELECT normalized_email, argMin(uid, (trial_ts, uid)) euid
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.uid uid, b.normalized_email normalized_email, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
      tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
      ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer
    FROM base b
    INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = b.uid
    INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = b.uid
    WHERE b.normalized_email != ''
  ) WHERE c_campaign_id IN ({p_cid_0:String}, {p_cid_1:String}) AND c_traffic_source IN ({p_tsrc_0:String}) AND u_country IN ({p_country_0:String}) AND u_card_type IN ({p_card_0:String}) AND u_platform IN ({p_plat_0:String}) AND (u_media_buyer IN ({p_mb_0:String}) OR uid IN (SELECT user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, argMin(utm_source, (event_time, transaction_id)) first_trial_utm FROM analytics_transactions FINAL WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND is_success = 1 AND transaction_type = 'trial' GROUP BY user_id) WHERE first_trial_utm IN ({p_mbutm_0:String})))
  GROUP BY normalized_email
),
etok AS (
  SELECT ce.euid uid, b.tid tid, b.et et, b.ets ets, b.tprio tprio, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
    b.is_success is_success, b.g g, b.nn nn, b.rr rr,
    floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    b.statusType statusType, b.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    b.cur cur, b.amt amt, b.pid pid, b.pname pname,
    '' dr, 0 pre_lvl,
    tr.c_date c_date, tr.c_funnel c_funnel, tr.c_camp c_camp,
    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    ud.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, ud.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    0 lvl, 0 slot,
    if(b.statusType != '', b.statusType, 'token_purchase') lt,
    b.pp pp, b.psig psig, 'token_purchase' ocat, 'email_token' orule
  FROM base b
  INNER JOIN cemail ce ON ce.normalized_email = b.normalized_email
  INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = ce.euid
  INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = ce.euid
  WHERE b.uid NOT IN (SELECT uid FROM tr)
    AND (b.ttype = 'token_purchase' OR (b.statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND b.tokenAmt))
    AND floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) >= 0
),
-- Payment-failure columns (cohortPaymentFailures.ts) live here, not in
-- classifierSQL: the snapshot rebuild and the Users / Payment pages share that
-- classifier and must not change. dr = the stored decline_reason of a failed
-- row; pre_lvl = the lifecycle level the user had before the row.
fdr AS (
  SELECT transaction_id tid, if(decline_reason = '', 'unknown', decline_reason) dr
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND status = 'failed'
),
finx AS (
  SELECT f.uid uid, f.tid tid, f.et et, f.ets ets, f.tprio tprio, f.trial_ts trial_ts, f.is_success is_success,
    f.g g, f.nn nn, f.rr rr, f.d d, f.statusType statusType, f.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    f.cur cur, f.amt amt, f.pid pid, f.pname pname,
    if(f.statusType = 'failed_payment', if(fdr.dr = '', 'unknown', fdr.dr), '') dr, ifNull(max(if(f.is_success = 1, f.lvl, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uid ORDER BY f.ets, f.tprio, f.tid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) pre_lvl,
    f.c_date c_date, f.c_funnel c_funnel, f.c_camp c_camp, f.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, f.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    f.u_country u_country, f.u_card_type u_card_type, f.u_platform u_platform, f.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    f.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, f.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    f.lvl lvl, f.slot slot, f.lt lt, f.pp pp, f.psig psig, f.ocat ocat, f.orule orule, 0 via_email
  FROM fin AS f LEFT JOIN fdr ON fdr.tid = f.tid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT uid, tid, et, ets, tprio, trial_ts, is_success, g, nn, rr, d, statusType, tokenAmt,
    cur, amt, pid, pname, dr, pre_lvl, c_date, c_funnel, c_camp, c_campaign_id, c_traffic_source,
    u_country, u_card_type, u_platform, u_media_buyer, u_normalized_email, u_source_updated_at,
    lvl, slot, lt, pp, psig, ocat, orule, 1 via_email
  FROM etok
)
, scoped AS (SELECT * FROM finx WHERE c_camp = {fk_camp:String} AND c_date >= {fk_from:String} AND c_date <= {fk_to:String} AND c_funnel IN ({p_fk_f_0:String}, {p_fk_f_1:String}) AND c_campaign_id IN ({p_cid_0:String}, {p_cid_1:String}) AND c_traffic_source IN ({p_tsrc_0:String}) AND u_country IN ({p_country_0:String}) AND u_card_type IN ({p_card_0:String}) AND u_platform IN ({p_plat_0:String}) AND (u_media_buyer IN ({p_mb_0:String}) OR uid IN (SELECT user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, argMin(utm_source, (event_time, transaction_id)) first_trial_utm FROM analytics_transactions FINAL WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND is_success = 1 AND transaction_type = 'trial' GROUP BY user_id) WHERE first_trial_utm IN ({p_mbutm_0:String}))))
SELECT cur currency,
    uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'trial') trial_users,
    countIf(is_success = 1) transactions,
    sumIf(amt, is_success = 1) gross_original,
    sumIf(g, is_success = 1) gross_usd,
    sumIf(nn, is_success = 1) net_usd,
    sum(rr) refunds_usd
    FROM scoped GROUP BY cur
FORMAT JSONEachRow

WITH

      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''

  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,
    max(c.user_requested) cf_user_requested,
    max(c.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto)) cf_auto_failed,

      AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND c.cancelled_at < c.period_ends_at))) cf_user,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),

    AND fc.funnel IN ({p_mfn_0:String}, {p_mfn_1:String}) AND fc.campaign_path IN ({p_mcp_0:String}, {p_mcp_1:String}) AND fc.campaign_id IN ({p_mcid_0:String}) AND fc.traffic_source IN ({p_mtsrc_0:String}) AND (fc.media_buyer IN ({p_mmb_0:String}) OR fc.trial_transaction_id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM analytics_transactions FINAL WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND utm_source IN ({p_mmbutm_0:String}))) AND fc.country IN ({p_mcountry_0:String}) AND fc.card_type IN ({p_mcard_0:String}) AND fc.platform IN ({p_mplat_0:String}) AND fc.currency IN ({p_mcur_0:String}) AND fc.price_plan IN ({p_mplan_0:String})
),
pretyped AS (
  SELECT *, floor((ets - trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upsell',
      (NOT tokenAmt) AND tid = trial_transaction_id, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'upsell',
      tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      'lifecycle') ocat,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upmark',
      (NOT tokenAmt) AND tid = trial_transaction_id, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'price_marked',
      tokenAmt, 'token_amount',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'common_up',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'fallback_app_2m',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'fallback_token_48h',
      'lifecycle') orule,
    if(statusType != '', statusType, ocat) pretype
  FROM base
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (
  SELECT p.uid uid, p.tid tid, p.et et, p.is_success is_success,
    p.g g, p.rr rr, p.d d,
    p.c_d c_d, p.c_camp c_camp, p.c_plan c_plan,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid)
)
SELECT toString(toDate(et)) day,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1) gross,
  sum(rr) refunds,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toDate(et) = c_d) gross_new_day,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) gross_new_week,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) gross_new_month,
  sumIf(rr, toDate(et) = c_d) refunds_new_day,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) refunds_new_week,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) refunds_new_month,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND c_d > toDate(et)) future_cohort_gross,
  
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'trial') type_trial,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'first_subscription') type_first_sub,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal')) type_renewals,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('upsell','app_upsell')) type_upsells,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') type_tokens,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1) paying_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toDate(et) = c_d) new_paying_users_day,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) new_paying_users_week,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) new_paying_users_month,
  countIf(is_success = 1) rows_scanned
FROM fin
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
FORMAT JSONEachRow

    arrayExists(value -> trim(BOTH ' ' FROM value) != '', [JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, 'metadata', '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, 'raw', '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, 'raw', 'metadata', '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(a.raw_payload, '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(a.raw_payload, 'metadata', '_fbc'), JSONExtractString(JSONExtractString(a.raw_payload, 'metadata'), '_fbc')]) has_fbc,

WITH
    fbc AS (SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id FROM fact_facebook_stats FINAL WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND level = {level:String} AND buyer IN ({p_buyer_0:String}, {p_buyer_1:String}) AND campaign_id != ''),
    txc AS (SELECT DISTINCT campaign_id FROM analytics_transactions FINAL WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND campaign_id != '')
  SELECT
    (SELECT count() FROM fbc) fb_campaigns,
    (SELECT count() FROM txc) tx_campaigns,
    (SELECT count() FROM fbc WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM txc)) matched_campaigns,
    (SELECT uniqExactIf(user_id, is_trial = 1 AND is_success = 1) FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
      WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND campaign_id != '' AND campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM fbc)) trial_users,
    (SELECT sumIf(gross_amount_usd, is_success = 1) FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
      WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND campaign_id != '' AND campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM fbc)) tx_gross,
    (SELECT sum(refund_amount_usd) FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
      WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND campaign_id != '' AND campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM fbc)) tx_refunds
  FORMAT JSONEachRow

WITH

support_emails AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM normalized_email)) AS normalized_email
  FROM fact_support_requests FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM normalized_email)) != ''
),
csub AS (
  SELECT s.normalized_email sub_email, s.subscription_id sid, s.cancelled_at cancelled_at, s.period_ends_at period_ends_at,
    s.started_at started_at,
    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM s.cancellation_reason)) = 'user requested cancellation' user_requested,
    (s.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.period_ends_at > now64(3, 'UTC')
      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''
  ) AS ft ON ft.fail_email = c.sub_email
  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,
    max(c.user_requested) cf_user_requested,
    max(c.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto)) cf_auto_failed,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND (c.user_requested OR (c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
      AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND c.cancelled_at < c.period_ends_at))) cf_user,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),

upp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT price_point FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND price_point != '' AND positionCaseInsensitive(billing_reason, 'upsell') > 0
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.user_id uid, a.transaction_id tid, a.event_time et, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(a.event_time) ets,
    a.normalized_email normalized_email, ifNull(a.source_updated_at, a.clickhouse_synced_at) source_updated_at,
    a.funnel funnel, a.campaign_path campaign_path,
    a.campaign_id campaign_id,
    ifNull(nullIf(JSONExtractString(a.normalized_payload, 'traffic_source'), ''), 'unknown') traffic_source,
    a.country_code country_code, a.card_type card_type, a.platform platform, a.media_buyer media_buyer,
    multiIf(a.transaction_type = 'trial', 0, a.transaction_type = 'upsell', 1, a.transaction_type = 'first_subscription', 2,
      a.transaction_type IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal'), 3, 4) tprio,
    a.status status, a.is_success is_success, a.transaction_type ttype,
    positionCaseInsensitive(a.billing_reason, 'upsell') > 0 upmark,
    ((a.currency = 'USD' AND (abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 4.99) < 0.005 OR abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 9.99) < 0.005 OR abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 24.99) < 0.005))
      OR (a.currency = 'EUR' AND abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 4.99) < 0.005)
      OR (a.currency = 'COP' AND abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 17199) < 0.005)) tokenAmt,
    abs(toFloat64(a.original_amount) - 14.98) < 0.01 commonUp,
    multiIf(a.status = 'failed', 'failed_payment', a.status = 'refunded', 'refund', a.status = 'chargeback', 'chargeback', '') statusType,
    a.gross_amount_usd g, floor(a.net_amount_usd * 100 + 0.5) / 100 nn, floor(a.refund_amount_usd * 100 + 0.5) / 100 rr,
    a.currency cur, toFloat64(a.original_amount) amt, a.product_id pid, a.product_name pname,

    argMin(if(media_buyer = '', 'Unknown', media_buyer), (ets, tid)) u_media_buyer,

    max(source_updated_at) u_source_updated_at
  FROM base GROUP BY uid

cl AS (
  SELECT e.uid uid, e.tid tid, e.et et, e.ets ets,
    e.normalized_email normalized_email, e.source_updated_at source_updated_at,
    e.funnel funnel, e.campaign_path campaign_path, e.campaign_id campaign_id, e.traffic_source traffic_source,

    e.cur cur, e.amt amt, e.pid pid, e.pname pname, e.lifeelig lifeelig,
    e.pp pp, e.psig psig,

    multiIf(upmark, 'upsell',
      lifeelig AND (ets, tprio, tid) = trial_key, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'upsell',
      tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      'lifecycle') ocat,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upmark',
      lifeelig AND (ets, tprio, tid) = trial_key, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'price_marked',

      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'common_up',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'fallback_app_2m',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'fallback_token_48h',
      'lifecycle') orule,
    if(statusType != '', statusType, ocat) pretype
  FROM cl
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
upsidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) slot FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'upsell' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (

    p.is_success is_success, p.g g, p.nn nn, p.rr rr, p.d d, p.statusType statusType, p.tokenAmt tokenAmt,

    p.u_country u_country, p.u_card_type u_card_type, p.u_platform u_platform, p.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    p.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, p.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl, ifNull(ui.slot, 0) slot,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid) LEFT JOIN upsidx ui USING(uid, tid)
)

cemail AS (
  SELECT normalized_email, argMin(uid, (trial_ts, uid)) euid
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.uid uid, b.normalized_email normalized_email, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
      tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
      ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer
    FROM base b
    INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = b.uid
    INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = b.uid
    WHERE b.normalized_email != ''
  ) 
  GROUP BY normalized_email
),
etok AS (
  SELECT ce.euid uid, b.tid tid, b.et et, b.ets ets, b.tprio tprio, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
    b.is_success is_success, b.g g, b.nn nn, b.rr rr,
    floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    b.statusType statusType, b.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    b.cur cur, b.amt amt, b.pid pid, b.pname pname,
    '' dr, 0 pre_lvl,
    tr.c_date c_date, tr.c_funnel c_funnel, tr.c_camp c_camp,
    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    ud.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, ud.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    0 lvl, 0 slot,
    if(b.statusType != '', b.statusType, 'token_purchase') lt,
    b.pp pp, b.psig psig, 'token_purchase' ocat, 'email_token' orule
  FROM base b
  INNER JOIN cemail ce ON ce.normalized_email = b.normalized_email
  INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = ce.euid
  INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = ce.euid
  WHERE b.uid NOT IN (SELECT uid FROM tr)
    AND (b.ttype = 'token_purchase' OR (b.statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND b.tokenAmt))
    AND floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) >= 0
),

-- classifierSQL: the snapshot rebuild and the Users / Payment pages share that
-- classifier and must not change. dr = the stored decline_reason of a failed
-- row; pre_lvl = the lifecycle level the user had before the row.
fdr AS (
  SELECT transaction_id tid, if(decline_reason = '', 'unknown', decline_reason) dr
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND status = 'failed'
),
finx AS (
  SELECT f.uid uid, f.tid tid, f.et et, f.ets ets, f.tprio tprio, f.trial_ts trial_ts, f.is_success is_success,

    f.cur cur, f.amt amt, f.pid pid, f.pname pname,
    if(f.statusType = 'failed_payment', if(fdr.dr = '', 'unknown', fdr.dr), '') dr, ifNull(max(if(f.is_success = 1, f.lvl, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uid ORDER BY f.ets, f.tprio, f.tid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) pre_lvl,

    f.lvl lvl, f.slot slot, f.lt lt, f.pp pp, f.psig psig, f.ocat ocat, f.orule orule, 0 via_email
  FROM fin AS f LEFT JOIN fdr ON fdr.tid = f.tid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT uid, tid, et, ets, tprio, trial_ts, is_success, g, nn, rr, d, statusType, tokenAmt,
    cur, amt, pid, pname, dr, pre_lvl, c_date, c_funnel, c_camp, c_campaign_id, c_traffic_source,

    lvl, slot, lt, pp, psig, ocat, orule, 1 via_email
  FROM etok
)

  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_renewal,

  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_renewal,

WITH
support_emails AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM normalized_email)) AS normalized_email
  FROM fact_support_requests FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM normalized_email)) != ''
),
csub AS (
  SELECT s.normalized_email sub_email, s.subscription_id sid, s.cancelled_at cancelled_at, s.period_ends_at period_ends_at,
    s.started_at started_at,
    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM s.cancellation_reason)) = 'user requested cancellation' user_requested,
    (s.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.period_ends_at > now64(3, 'UTC')
      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''
  ) AS ft ON ft.fail_email = c.sub_email
  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,
    max(c.user_requested) cf_user_requested,
    max(c.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto)) cf_auto_failed,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND (c.user_requested OR (c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
      AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND c.cancelled_at < c.period_ends_at))) cf_user,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),

upp AS (

'price_01M2SSMMES8JY55CMX80GKHCYX') OR startsWith(a.price_point, 'price_web_tokens'), 'token_purchase',

  FROM analytics_transactions AS a FINAL

elig AS (SELECT *, (statusType = '' AND NOT upmark AND NOT tokenAmt) lifeelig FROM base),
tr AS (
  SELECT uid, argMin(ets, (ets, tprio, tid)) trial_ts, min((ets, tprio, tid)) trial_key,
    argMin(toString(toDate(et)), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_date,
    argMin(funnel, (ets, tprio, tid)) c_funnel,
    argMin(if(campaign_path = '', 'unknown', campaign_path), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_camp,
    argMin(if(campaign_id = '', 'unknown', campaign_id), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_campaign_id,
    argMin(if(traffic_source = '', 'unknown', traffic_source), (ets, tprio, tid)) c_traffic_source
  FROM elig WHERE lifeelig GROUP BY uid
),
userdim AS (
  SELECT uid,
    argMin(country_code, (multiIf(country_code = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_country,
    argMin(if(card_type = '', 'unknown', card_type), (multiIf(card_type = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_card_type,
    argMin(if(platform = '', 'unknown', platform), (multiIf(platform = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_platform,
    argMin(if(media_buyer = '', 'Unknown', media_buyer), (ets, tid)) u_media_buyer,
    argMin(normalized_email, (multiIf(normalized_email = '', 2, is_success = 1, 0, 1), ets, tid)) u_normalized_email,
    max(source_updated_at) u_source_updated_at
  FROM base GROUP BY uid
),
cl AS (
  SELECT e.uid uid, e.tid tid, e.et et, e.ets ets,
    e.normalized_email normalized_email, e.source_updated_at source_updated_at,
    e.funnel funnel, e.campaign_path campaign_path, e.campaign_id campaign_id, e.traffic_source traffic_source,
    e.country_code country_code, e.card_type card_type, e.media_buyer media_buyer,
    e.tprio tprio, e.status status, e.is_success is_success, e.upmark upmark, e.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    e.commonUp commonUp, e.statusType statusType, e.g g, e.nn nn, e.rr rr,
    e.cur cur, e.amt amt, e.pid pid, e.pname pname, e.lifeelig lifeelig,
    e.pp pp, e.psig psig,
    tr.trial_ts trial_ts, tr.trial_key trial_key, tr.c_date c_date, tr.c_funnel c_funnel, tr.c_camp c_camp,
	    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
	    userdim.u_country u_country, userdim.u_card_type u_card_type, userdim.u_platform u_platform, userdim.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
	    userdim.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, userdim.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at

),
pretyped AS (
  SELECT *, floor((ets - trial_ts) / 86400000) d,

      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'upsell',
      tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      'lifecycle') ocat,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upmark',
      lifeelig AND (ets, tprio, tid) = trial_key, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'price_marked',
      tokenAmt, 'token_amount',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'common_up',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'fallback_app_2m',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'fallback_token_48h',
      'lifecycle') orule,
    if(statusType != '', statusType, ocat) pretype
  FROM cl
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
upsidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) slot FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'upsell' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (
  SELECT p.uid uid, p.tid tid, p.et et, p.ets ets, p.tprio tprio, p.trial_ts trial_ts,
    p.is_success is_success, p.g g, p.nn nn, p.rr rr, p.d d, p.statusType statusType, p.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    p.cur cur, p.amt amt, p.pid pid, p.pname pname, p.pp pp, p.psig psig, p.ocat ocat, p.orule orule,
    p.c_date c_date, p.c_funnel c_funnel, p.c_camp c_camp,
    p.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, p.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    p.u_country u_country, p.u_card_type u_card_type, p.u_platform u_platform, p.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    p.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, p.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl, ifNull(ui.slot, 0) slot,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid) LEFT JOIN upsidx ui USING(uid, tid)
)
, 
cemail AS (
  SELECT normalized_email, argMin(uid, (trial_ts, uid)) euid
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.uid uid, b.normalized_email normalized_email, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
      tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
      ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer
    FROM base b
    INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = b.uid
    INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = b.uid
    WHERE b.normalized_email != ''
  ) WHERE c_campaign_id IN ({p_cid_0:String}, {p_cid_1:String})
  GROUP BY normalized_email
),
etok AS (
  SELECT ce.euid uid, b.tid tid, b.et et, b.ets ets, b.tprio tprio, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,
    b.is_success is_success, b.g g, b.nn nn, b.rr rr,
    floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    b.statusType statusType, b.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    b.cur cur, b.amt amt, b.pid pid, b.pname pname,
    '' dr, 0 pre_lvl,
    tr.c_date c_date, tr.c_funnel c_funnel, tr.c_camp c_camp,
    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    ud.u_country u_country, ud.u_card_type u_card_type, ud.u_platform u_platform, ud.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    ud.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, ud.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    0 lvl, 0 slot,
    if(b.statusType != '', b.statusType, 'token_purchase') lt,
    b.pp pp, b.psig psig, 'token_purchase' ocat, 'email_token' orule
  FROM base b
  INNER JOIN cemail ce ON ce.normalized_email = b.normalized_email
  INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = ce.euid
  INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = ce.euid
  WHERE b.uid NOT IN (SELECT uid FROM tr)
    AND (b.ttype = 'token_purchase' OR (b.statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND b.tokenAmt))
    AND floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) >= 0
),
-- Payment-failure columns (cohortPaymentFailures.ts) live here, not in
-- classifierSQL: the snapshot rebuild and the Users / Payment pages share that
-- classifier and must not change. dr = the stored decline_reason of a failed
-- row; pre_lvl = the lifecycle level the user had before the row.
fdr AS (
  SELECT transaction_id tid, if(decline_reason = '', 'unknown', decline_reason) dr
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND status = 'failed'
),
finx AS (
  SELECT f.uid uid, f.tid tid, f.et et, f.ets ets, f.tprio tprio, f.trial_ts trial_ts, f.is_success is_success,
    f.g g, f.nn nn, f.rr rr, f.d d, f.statusType statusType, f.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    f.cur cur, f.amt amt, f.pid pid, f.pname pname,
    if(f.statusType = 'failed_payment', if(fdr.dr = '', 'unknown', fdr.dr), '') dr, ifNull(max(if(f.is_success = 1, f.lvl, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uid ORDER BY f.ets, f.tprio, f.tid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) pre_lvl,
    f.c_date c_date, f.c_funnel c_funnel, f.c_camp c_camp, f.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, f.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    f.u_country u_country, f.u_card_type u_card_type, f.u_platform u_platform, f.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    f.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, f.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    f.lvl lvl, f.slot slot, f.lt lt, f.pp pp, f.psig psig, f.ocat ocat, f.orule orule, 0 via_email
  FROM fin AS f LEFT JOIN fdr ON fdr.tid = f.tid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT uid, tid, et, ets, tprio, trial_ts, is_success, g, nn, rr, d, statusType, tokenAmt,
    cur, amt, pid, pname, dr, pre_lvl, c_date, c_funnel, c_camp, c_campaign_id, c_traffic_source,
    u_country, u_card_type, u_platform, u_media_buyer, u_normalized_email, u_source_updated_at,
    lvl, slot, lt, pp, psig, ocat, orule, 1 via_email
  FROM etok
)
, scoped AS (SELECT * FROM finx WHERE c_date = {ck_date:String} AND c_funnel = {ck_funnel:String} AND c_camp = {ck_camp:String} AND c_campaign_id IN ({p_cid_0:String}, {p_cid_1:String}))
, plankey AS (
      SELECT uid,
        countIf(is_success = 1 AND lt NOT IN ('upsell','token_purchase','app_upsell')) plan_candidates,
        argMinIf(round(g, 2), (ets, tprio, tid), is_success = 1 AND lt NOT IN ('upsell','token_purchase','app_upsell')) plan_price
      FROM scoped GROUP BY uid
    )
    SELECT
      if(plan_candidates = 0, 'Unknown', concat('$', toString(plan_price))) plan_name,
      if(plan_candidates = 0, 0, plan_price) price,
      uniqExact(uid) trial_users,
  sum(if(is_success = 1, g, 0)) gross_raw, sum(rr) refund_raw,
  uniqExactIf(uid, rr > 0) refund_users,
  sum(if(is_success = 1 AND d = 0, nn, 0)) d0_raw, sum(if(is_success = 1 AND d <= 7, nn, 0)) d7_raw,
  sum(if(is_success = 1 AND d <= 14, nn, 0)) d14_raw, sum(if(is_success = 1 AND d <= 30, nn, 0)) d30_raw,
  sum(if(is_success = 1 AND d <= 60, nn, 0)) d60_raw,
  sumIf(nn, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'trial') trial_rev_raw,
  sumIf(nn, is_success = 1 AND lvl = 1) first_sub_rev_raw, sumIf(nn, is_success = 1 AND lvl >= 2) renewal_rev_raw,
  sumIf(nn, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'upsell') upsell_rev_raw,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 1) first_subscription_users, uniqExactIf(uid, lvl >= 2) renewal_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 2) r2, uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 3) r3, uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 4) r4, uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 5) r5, uniqExactIf(uid, lvl = 6) r6,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'upsell') upsell_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'upsell') funnel_upsell_users, sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'upsell') funnel_upsell_rev_raw,
  uniqExactIf(uid, slot = 1) upsell_1_users, uniqExactIf(uid, slot = 2) upsell_2_users, uniqExactIf(uid, slot = 3) upsell_3_users, uniqExactIf(uid, slot >= 4) upsell_extra_users,
  sumIf(g, slot = 1) u1_raw, sumIf(g, slot = 2) u2_raw, sumIf(g, slot = 3) u3_raw, sumIf(g, slot >= 4) uextra_raw,
  countIf(is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') token_purchases, uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') token_buyers,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') token_gross_raw,
  sumIf(rr, lt = 'token_purchase' OR (statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND (ocat = 'token_purchase' OR via_email = 1))) token_refund_raw,
  countIf(is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase' AND via_email = 1) token_email_purchases,
  countIf(is_success = 1 AND lt = 'app_upsell') app_upsell_purchases,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'app_upsell') app_upsell_buyers,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'app_upsell') app_upsell_gross_raw,
  sumIf(rr, lt = 'app_upsell' OR (statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND ocat = 'app_upsell')) app_upsell_refund_raw,
  uniqExactIf(
    uid,
    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != ''
    AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT normalized_email FROM support_emails)
  ) support_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment') failed_payment_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0) failed_after_trial_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000) failed_at_checkout_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000) failed_first_charge_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1) failed_after_first_subscription_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2) failed_after_renewal_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets < trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_checkout,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 0 AND ets >= trial_ts + 7200000 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_first_charge,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl = 1 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_first_sub,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND pre_lvl >= 2 AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_renewal,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('insufficient_funds')) decline_insufficient_funds_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('fraud_suspected')) decline_fraud_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('card_not_supported')) decline_card_not_supported_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('do_not_honor', 'generic_decline')) decline_do_not_honor_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('authentication_failed')) decline_3ds_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr IN ('lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_card_lost_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, statusType = 'failed_payment' AND dr NOT IN ('insufficient_funds', 'fraud_suspected', 'card_not_supported', 'do_not_honor', 'generic_decline', 'authentication_failed', 'lost_card', 'stolen_card', 'expired_card')) decline_other_users_all,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags)) cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_user_requested = 1 OR (cf_auto_failed = 0 AND cf_user = 1))) user_cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_user_requested = 0 AND (cf_auto_failed = 1 OR (cf_user = 0 AND cf_auto_period = 1)))) auto_cancelled_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) != '' AND lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM u_normalized_email)) IN (SELECT sub_email FROM cflags WHERE cf_still_paid = 1)) cancelled_active_users
    FROM (
      SELECT s.*, pk.plan_candidates plan_candidates, pk.plan_price plan_price
      FROM scoped s INNER JOIN plankey pk ON pk.uid = s.uid
    )
    GROUP BY plan_name, price
    ORDER BY plan_name = 'Unknown', price

    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM s.cancellation_reason)) = 'user requested cancellation' user_requested,
    (s.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.period_ends_at > now64(3, 'UTC')
      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''
  ) AS ft ON ft.fail_email = c.sub_email
  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,

      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),

  FROM base b
  INNER JOIN cemail ce ON ce.normalized_email = b.normalized_email
  INNER JOIN tr ON tr.uid = ce.euid
  INNER JOIN userdim ud ON ud.uid = ce.euid
  WHERE b.uid NOT IN (SELECT uid FROM tr)
    AND (b.ttype = 'token_purchase' OR (b.statusType IN ('refund','chargeback') AND b.tokenAmt))
    AND floor((b.ets - tr.trial_ts) / 86400000) >= 0
),
-- Payment-failure columns (cohortPaymentFailures.ts) live here, not in
-- classifierSQL: the snapshot rebuild and the Users / Payment pages share that
-- classifier and must not change. dr = the stored decline_reason of a failed
-- row; pre_lvl = the lifecycle level the user had before the row.
fdr AS (
  SELECT transaction_id tid, if(decline_reason = '', 'unknown', decline_reason) dr
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND status = 'failed'
),
finx AS (
  SELECT f.uid uid, f.tid tid, f.et et, f.ets ets, f.tprio tprio, f.trial_ts trial_ts, f.is_success is_success,
    f.g g, f.nn nn, f.rr rr, f.d d, f.statusType statusType, f.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    f.cur cur, f.amt amt, f.pid pid, f.pname pname,
    if(f.statusType = 'failed_payment', if(fdr.dr = '', 'unknown', fdr.dr), '') dr, ifNull(max(if(f.is_success = 1, f.lvl, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uid ORDER BY f.ets, f.tprio, f.tid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) pre_lvl,
    f.c_date c_date, f.c_funnel c_funnel, f.c_camp c_camp, f.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, f.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,
    f.u_country u_country, f.u_card_type u_card_type, f.u_platform u_platform, f.u_media_buyer u_media_buyer,
    f.u_normalized_email u_normalized_email, f.u_source_updated_at u_source_updated_at,
    f.lvl lvl, f.slot slot, f.lt lt, f.pp pp, f.psig psig, f.ocat ocat, f.orule orule, 0 via_email
  FROM fin AS f LEFT JOIN fdr ON fdr.tid = f.tid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT uid, tid, et, ets, tprio, trial_ts, is_success, g, nn, rr, d, statusType, tokenAmt,
    cur, amt, pid, pname, dr, pre_lvl, c_date, c_funnel, c_camp, c_campaign_id, c_traffic_source,
    u_country, u_card_type, u_platform, u_media_buyer, u_normalized_email, u_source_updated_at,
    lvl, slot, lt, pp, psig, ocat, orule, 1 via_email
  FROM etok
)
, scoped AS (SELECT * FROM finx WHERE c_date = {ck_date:String} AND c_funnel = {ck_funnel:String} AND c_camp = {ck_camp:String} AND u_country IN ({p_country_0:String}, {p_country_1:String}))
SELECT if(pid != '', pid, pp) product_id, pname product, cur currency, round(amt, 2) price,
    count() purchases, uniqExact(uid) buyers, sum(g) gross_revenue
    FROM scoped WHERE is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase' GROUP BY product_id, pname, cur, round(amt, 2)
FORMAT JSONEachRow

    fc.cohort_date c_d, fc.campaign_path c_camp, fc.price_plan c_plan,
    fc.trial_transaction_id trial_transaction_id,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(fc.trial_event_time) trial_ts
  FROM analytics_transactions AS a FINAL
  INNER JOIN fact_user_cohorts AS fc FINAL
    ON fc.auth_user_id = a.auth_user_id
   AND fc.canonical_user_id = a.user_id
  WHERE a.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND fc.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String}
    AND fc.warehouse_version = {warehouse_version:String}
    AND fc.classification_version = {classification_version:String}
    AND floor((toUnixTimestamp64Milli(a.event_time) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(fc.trial_event_time)) / 86400000) >= 0
    
),
pretyped AS (
  SELECT *, floor((ets - trial_ts) / 86400000) d,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upsell',
      (NOT tokenAmt) AND tid = trial_transaction_id, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'upsell',
      tokenAmt, 'token_purchase',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'app_upsell',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'token_purchase',
      'lifecycle') ocat,
    multiIf(upmark, 'upmark',
      (NOT tokenAmt) AND tid = trial_transaction_id, 'trial',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'app_upsell', 'app_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'token_purchase', 'token_id',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000 AND psig = 'upsell', 'price_marked',
      tokenAmt, 'token_amount',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 3600000 AND commonUp, 'common_up',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 120000 AND pp != '', 'fallback_app_2m',
      (ets - trial_ts) <= 172800000, 'fallback_token_48h',
      'lifecycle') orule,
    if(statusType != '', statusType, ocat) pretype
  FROM base
),
lifeidx AS (SELECT uid, tid, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY ets, tprio, tid) lvl FROM pretyped WHERE pretype = 'lifecycle' AND is_success = 1),
fin AS (
  SELECT p.uid uid, p.tid tid, p.et et, p.is_success is_success,
    p.g g, p.rr rr, p.d d,
    p.c_d c_d, p.c_camp c_camp, p.c_plan c_plan,
    ifNull(li.lvl, 0) lvl,
    multiIf(p.pretype != 'lifecycle', p.pretype, li.lvl = 1, 'first_subscription', li.lvl = 2, 'renewal_2', li.lvl = 3, 'renewal_3', 'renewal') lt
  FROM pretyped p LEFT JOIN lifeidx li USING(uid, tid)
)
SELECT c_camp key,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1) gross,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1) - sum(rr) net,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) gross_new,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1) - sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) gross_existing
FROM fin
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY key ORDER BY gross DESC
FORMAT JSONEachRow

WITH
support_emails AS (SELECT '' AS normalized_email WHERE 0),
csub AS (
  SELECT s.normalized_email sub_email, s.subscription_id sid, s.cancelled_at cancelled_at, s.period_ends_at period_ends_at,
    s.started_at started_at,
    lowerUTF8(trim(BOTH ' ' FROM s.cancellation_reason)) = 'user requested cancellation' user_requested,
    (s.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.period_ends_at > now64(3, 'UTC')
      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid
  FROM fact_subscriptions AS s FINAL
  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid
  FROM csub AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts
    FROM analytics_transactions AS f FINAL
    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''
  ) AS ft ON ft.fail_email = c.sub_email
  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
),
cflags AS (
  SELECT c.sub_email sub_email,
    max(c.user_requested) cf_user_requested,
    max(c.sid IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto)) cf_auto_failed,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND (c.user_requested OR (c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL
      AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND c.cancelled_at < c.period_ends_at))) cf_user,
    max(c.sid NOT IN (SELECT sid FROM cauto) AND c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND c.period_ends_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT c.user_requested AND c.cancelled_at >= c.period_ends_at) cf_auto_period,
    max(c.still_paid) cf_still_paid
  FROM csub AS c
  GROUP BY c.sub_email
),
upp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT price_point FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND price_point != '' AND positionCaseInsensitive(billing_reason, 'upsell') > 0
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.user_id uid, a.transaction_id tid, a.event_time et, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(a.event_time) ets,
    multiIf(a.transaction_type = 'trial', 0, a.transaction_type = 'upsell', 1, a.transaction_type = 'first_subscription', 2,
      a.transaction_type IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal'), 3, 4) tprio,
    a.status status, a.is_success is_success,

  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''

etok AS (
  SELECT ce.euid uid, b.tid tid, b.et et, b.ets ets, b.tprio tprio, tr.trial_ts trial_ts,

    b.statusType statusType, b.tokenAmt tokenAmt,
    b.cur cur, b.amt amt, b.pid pid, b.pname pname,

    tr.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, tr.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,

-- Payment-failure columns (cohortPaymentFailures.ts) live here, not in
-- classifierSQL: the snapshot rebuild and the Users / Payment pages share that
-- classifier and must not change. dr = the stored decline_reason of a failed
-- row; pre_lvl = the lifecycle level the user had before the row.
fdr AS (
  SELECT transaction_id tid, if(decline_reason = '', 'unknown', decline_reason) dr
  FROM analytics_transactions FINAL
  WHERE auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND status = 'failed'

    f.c_date c_date, f.c_funnel c_funnel, f.c_camp c_camp, f.c_campaign_id c_campaign_id, f.c_traffic_source c_traffic_source,

  FROM fin AS f LEFT JOIN fdr ON fdr.tid = f.tid

  SELECT uid, tid, et, ets, tprio, trial_ts, is_success, g, nn, rr, d, statusType, tokenAmt,
    cur, amt, pid, pname, dr, pre_lvl, c_date, c_funnel, c_camp, c_campaign_id, c_traffic_source,

    lvl, slot, lt, pp, psig, ocat, orule, 1 via_email
  FROM etok

  sumIf(rr, toDate(et) = c_d) refunds_new_day,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) refunds_new_week,
  sumIf(rr, toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) refunds_new_month,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND c_d > toDate(et)) future_cohort_gross,
  
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'trial') type_trial,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'first_subscription') type_first_sub,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('renewal_2','renewal_3','renewal')) type_renewals,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt IN ('upsell','app_upsell')) type_upsells,
  sumIf(g, is_success = 1 AND lt = 'token_purchase') type_tokens,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1) paying_users,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toDate(et) = c_d) new_paying_users_day,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfWeek(toDate(et), 1) = toStartOfWeek(c_d, 1)) new_paying_users_week,
  uniqExactIf(uid, is_success = 1 AND toStartOfMonth(toDate(et)) = toStartOfMonth(c_d)) new_paying_users_month,
  countIf(is_success = 1) rows_scanned
FROM fin
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

      AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'expired') = 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'unpaid') = 0) still_paid

  WHERE s.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND s.normalized_email != ''
    AND (positionCaseInsensitive(s.status, 'cancel') > 0 OR s.renews = 0)
),
cauto AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sid sid

  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT f.normalized_email fail_email, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(f.event_time) fts

    WHERE f.auth_user_id = {auth_user_id:String} AND f.status = 'failed' AND f.normalized_email != ''

  WHERE c.cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.user_requested
    AND ft.fts <= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at)
    AND ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.cancelled_at) - 172800000
    AND (c.started_at IS NULL OR ft.fts >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(c.started_at) + 7200000)
